finding.statement: The clay-direct-dev roundtrip path admitted every owner-created issue with one repeated title and had no semantic ordinary-dispatch identity, create-only claim, concurrency group, or result-key dedupe. Parallel go organs therefore created genealogically identical issue-triggered runs without adding measurement information.

hypothesis: A reusable ordinary probe needs semantic identity independent of go/macrocycle/time/run/issue/main movement, with a create-only claim before trigger creation; workflow concurrency and result dedupe are defense in depth.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AS_ROOT_FIX: concurrency can serialize jobs but does not prevent issue spam/run creation, does not establish a replay-stable semantic probe identity, and does not provide a create-before-trigger singleton boundary across independent go macrocycles.

parallel_convergence.note: The active Forge backlog-first wiring landed independently and was not duplicated by this receipt lane. A self-hosted backfill reconcile push run failed before jobs materialized, so it is infrastructure/workflow-start evidence only.
